metadata.title: New Drug Registration Detailed Requirements (Ministry of Health, Trinidad and Tobago)
metadata.edition: Updated September 2025 (1 September 2025 is a placeholder day) · 4.7 adverse event reports, 4.8 RMP, 4.9 PSUR/PAR (optional), 4.10 pharmacovigilance plan (optional); no post-registration reporting rule
metadata.legal_basis: Ministry of Health requirements under the Food and Drugs Act and Regulations, Chap. 30:01; the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
Candidates are not approved requirements. Read the original, qualifications and exceptions.
Scans, tables, other languages and implicit obligations may be missed. Zero candidates does not establish zero requirements.

candidates.statement: As much information as possible must be filled out on the forms provided.
candidates.context: In order to expedite the processing of your New Drug Submissions, please ensure/provide the following in duplicate: - 1.(a) The New Drug Submission Forms (Form A, B and C) are filled out properly. DO NOT PUT - “SEE DOSSIER” You may use a blank sheet of paper if more space is required and attach to the form.

candidates.statement: (b) All relevant technical data such as - clinical studies, product description, product formulation/specification, methods of analysis, certificate of analysis must be provided to support each new Drug Submission. (See detailed requirements attached).
candidates.context: DO NOT PUT - “SEE DOSSIER” You may use a blank sheet of paper if more space is required and attach to the form. 2. Each drug is properly certified - original “Free Sale Certificate”/ “Certificate of Pharmaceutical Product” (CPP) is required from the relevant Health Authorities.

candidates.statement: 1.2 Receipt Proof of payment totaling a cost of $750 or $100 paid at the Ministry of Health or any District Revenue Office must accompany each new drug submission or supplemental drug submission respectively. Receipts cannot be used for more than one product. Please present the original receipt for verification and a copy with your submission.
